description: From design/reference/wren-character-sheet.webp: the six palette chips (brown 99,71,52 / cream 202,177,145 / olive 98,94,66 / sage 94,104,85 / teal 76,108,104 / gold 193,152,90) plus direct samples off the figures and detail panels (sample coordinates in the build report). Warm tan skin sampled off the front view's lit face; messy brown hair; cream shirt; dark blue-teal vest; brown trousers; cream sock wraps with brown cross lacing; brown leather boots with brass buckles; braided rope sash; green-olive patched cloak with brown / khaki / sage patches and a brass clasp; two teal crystals (pendant + bracer diamond) = the ONLY glow, subtle; wooden pitchfork with a wrapped grip and brass ferrules.

skin.note: sampled: the front view's lit face, median rgb 192,139,100 = hue 25 deg, sat 0.48 (warm tan; the head panel's cheek 168,121,88 and the hand 183,124,88 agree in hue 23-25). Never Blender-default grey (the vampwarrior v4 lesson)

skin_shadow.note: authored shadow shapes (jaw / neck cast shadow, fringe shadow): the sheet's neck shadow 143,98,73 / 166,115,82, one step down in value at the same hue

lips.note: barely-there lip tint (a boy: no paint read)

mouth.note: the mouth line between the lips

liner.note: bold dark-brown upper lid line (the sheet's anime lid)

brow.note: bold brows, dark brown (the hair's shadow tone)

hair.note: messy brown: chip 1 (99,71,52) / the head panel's lit hair 108,74,51

hair_shade.note: lock undersides (the head panel's hair shadow 71,54,42)

hair_tie.note: leather tie on the nape tail

shirt.note: cream shirt: chip 2 (202,177,145) / sampled 188,159,128 on the lit sleeve

sleeve_roll.note: the rolled cuffs, a touch lighter (fold highlight)

vest.note: dark blue-teal vest: chip 5 (76,108,104) one step darker

trousers.note: sampled on the front view's trousers (135,98,73 / 132,98,73)

trousers_shade.note: inside the blouse / tunic (only seen at the openings)

wrap.note: cream-white sock wraps (sheet: lit 214,200,176 band; shadowed 168,140,111)

brass.note: chip 6 gold: buckles, rivets, clasp, crystal settings, pouch button

cloak.note: green-olive cloak between chips 3 / 4 (sampled 89,94,77 mid, 94,92,65 lit, 71,74,56 back)

cloak_worn.note: the sun-faded olive mottle (the sheet's yellow-olive wear)

patch_a.note: brown patch (sampled on the back view 112,87,59 / the patch panel 106,86,62)

patch_c.note: sage patch (chip 4, slightly off the cloak's green)

crystal.note: TEAL crystal (sampled on the necklace panel 89,177,162); the only glow, subtle

bracer.note: leather bracer (the bracer panel 71,55,42 in shadow)

material.note: the vampwarrior v3+ shaded material: Col x baked AO, baked normal map; no cel bands, no outline shells
